scope: current-source support while Lumen v530 v7 x1 completed

sources.name: OpenAI Codex changelog
sources.takeaway: Browser developer mode and app diagnostics remain the relevant current Codex surface for Lumen live-adapter hardening.

sources.name: MCP Roots specification
sources.takeaway: Roots define filesystem boundaries and should inform any future GHC multiplex IPC bus or sibling catch-up surface.

sources.name: MCP Transports specification
sources.takeaway: Stdio and Streamable HTTP transports reinforce the need for explicit encoding, boundary, and lifecycle receipts.

sources.name: MCP Tools specification
sources.takeaway: Tool exposure should stay schema-bounded and status-observable, not raw-session driven.

sources.name: OWASP Agentic AI threats and mitigations
sources.takeaway: Agentic workflows need threat-model-based controls around autonomy, tool use, memory, and multi-agent coordination.

sources.name: GitHub Actions secure use reference
sources.takeaway: Least privilege, untrusted input separation, and exact scoping remain mandatory for repo automation.

x2_use: Keep omega-mini first for all sibling catch-up and only consult full omega for specific archive fallback.
Promote Lumen advisory outputs through Aletheon-local reducers rather than raw transcript publication.
Use MCP roots and transport boundaries as design constraints for future multiplex runner work.
Use OWASP and GitHub guidance to keep tool autonomy bounded by exact publication and least-privilege guards.
